QUIC retry integration tests and stream send/receive checks.

# Purpose
This file is a QUIC integration test program. It creates a server `fd_quic_t` and a client `fd_quic_t`, connects them with `fd_quic_virtual_pair`, and drives both endpoints with repeated calls to `fd_quic_service`. The test checks handshake completion, connection creation, retry packet handling, packet and byte metrics, and stream data delivery. The callback [`my_stream_rx_cb`](<#my_stream_rx_cb>) verifies that received stream data matches the expected size and content, while [`my_connection_new`](<#my_connection_new>) and [`my_handshake_complete`](<#my_handshake_complete>) record when the server and client finish the handshake.

The file contains two test cases. [`test_retry_integration`](<#test_retry_integration>) checks the normal retry flow, then opens streams, sends data, closes the connection, and waits for ACK processing. [`test_initial_token_odd_sz`](<#test_initial_token_odd_sz>) creates an Initial packet with a 46-byte token and verifies that the server sends a Retry packet and updates token-length metrics as expected. The [`main`](<#main>) function sets up the workspace, QUIC limits, callbacks, and configuration, then runs both tests and frees all allocated resources before exit.
